versions.changelog:
Initial release: comprehensive website audit skill

- Provides step-by-step methods to audit website performance, broken links, accessibility, security headers, and SEO.
- Includes code snippets (curl, Python, bash) for programmatic checks and automated scripts.
- Offers guidance on using popular open-source tools (Lighthouse, axe-core, pa11y, LinkChecker).
- Supplies a Markdown website audit report template.
- Designed for thorough technical and user experience site health checks.
